title: Projection at the unit along a proper section
statement:
Let \(A\) be a finite commutative ring and let \(s:X\to W\) and \(p:W\to X\) be proper morphisms of schemes such that \(s;p=\mathrm{id}_X\). Write \(S=Rs_!\), \(P=Rp_!\), and \(U=S(\mathbf1_X)\). Let \(\alpha:\mathrm{Id}\simeq P\circ S\) denote properSectionPushIso, constructed from the canonical identity, equality and composition comparisons, and let \(\ell:s^*\circ p^*\simeq\mathrm{Id}\) denote leftDerivedUpperStarCompSectionIso (semicolons in the formula denote composition in application order). Let \(\kappa:S\simeq U\otimes p^*(-)\) be properSectionTensorIso, the actual composite of the inverse pullback section comparison, its pushforward, and projectionUnitIso; its component is \(\kappa_M=S(\ell_M^{-1});\operatorname{projectionUnitIso}_s(p^*M)\). Use the canonical tensor, symmetry, right unitor \(\rho\), projectionUnitIso and outside-first orderedProjection \(\pi\) of [def-sf-supported-diagonal-calculus]. For every \(M\in D_A(X)\),
\[
\alpha_M;P\bigl(\kappa_M;\operatorname{swap}_{U,p^*M}\bigr)
=\rho_M^{-1};(\mathrm{id}_M\otimes\alpha_{\mathbf1_X});\pi_{p,M,U}.
\]

source.place: Projection naturality in both diagonal-coordinate triangle computations, specialized to the unit of an arbitrary proper section. Stacks Project: sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 0B56; categories.tex, Tag 0DV0.

proof.text: Use canonical proper projection composition for s,p and the equal composite id. Naturality of its direct-image compositor moves the pullback section comparison inward. The pullback compositor followed by that section comparison equals the identity pullback comparison. Apply canonical identity projection normalization, obtaining the section projection square for every inside factor V.

Specialize V to the tensor unit. The inverse of properSectionTensorIso is computed from its actual isomorphism factors, using a generic functor-category calculation. Postcompose the section square with the twice-pushed left unitor. Its naturality and naturality of properSectionPushIso give the unordered unit square; cancel the inverse section tensor isomorphism. Naturality of canonical tensor symmetry moves the unit component of the section push isomorphism past the swap. The canonical equality rho_M.inv followed by beta_(M,1) equals lambda_M.inv yields exactly orderedProjection.

proof_origin.place: Q2: complete section/unit cancellation from canonical proper projection composition and canonical identity projection normalization.

theorem properSectionProjectionUnit {X W : Scheme.{u}} (s : X ⟶ W) (p : W ⟶ X)
    [IsProper s] [IsProper p] (h : s ≫ p = 𝟙 X) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) :
    (properSectionPushIso A s p h).hom.app M ≫
        (push A p).map
          ((properSectionTensorIso A s p h).hom.app M ≫
            (CoordinateTrace.swap A W
              ((push A s).obj (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X))
              ((CoordinateTrace.pull A p).obj M)).hom) =
      (unitRightUnitor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X M).inv ≫
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj M).map
          ((properSectionPushIso A s p h).hom.app
            (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X)) ≫
        (orderedProjection A p M
          ((push A s).obj (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X))).hom
